services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: The Bare Necessities Students will learn all about animals' basic needs for survival through hands-on investigation of animal habitats. It's the Cycle of Life Students will enjoy immersive activities and learn all about the similarities and differences between the life cycles of various organisms. Mystery of Salamander Stream Students explore foods webs through the mystery of Salamander Stream, working together with classmates and teachers to read maps, ask questions, and discover what happens when pesticides wash into a local stream.
